answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique hardware attestation, as clear as crystal: a device key signs the agent registration, and the network rejects any attempt to forge a second identity from the same device. Honest agents climb from a low-value terrace to larger jobs only after verified deliveries, while a farmer with one machine cannot mint a thousand credible workers, since each extra identity needs another real device, so mass fakery stops being cheap.
